sections.title: باب 1 — متن (26)

paras.text: (continued from p.25) … can be arranged. In this verse this too has been said, that whatever the Messenger, the Noble Prophet ﷺ, gives you, take it happily, and whatever he forbids you, stop from it. Indeed Allah is severe in punishment.

paras.text: Translation: Your Lord knows well that you and the people with you sometimes stand at night nearly two-thirds of the night, and sometimes half the night, and sometimes a third of the night; and Allah keeps the measure of night and day. He knew that you would not be able to keep it up, so He was kind to you; so read as much of the Quran as is easy. He knew that some of you would be sick, and some would travel in the land seeking the bounty of Allah, i.e. livelihood, and some would fight in the way of Allah; so read as much as is easily possible, and keep establishing prayer and paying zakat, and keep giving Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good deed you send ahead for yourselves, you will find it with Allah better and greater in reward. And keep asking Allah for forgiveness; indeed Allah is forgiving and merciful.
paras.urdu: ترجمہ: تمہارا پروردگار خوب جانتا ہے کہ تم اور تمہارے ساتھ کے لوگ کبھی دو تہائی رات کے قریب اور کبھی آدھی رات اور کبھی تہائی رات قیام کیا کرتے ہو اور اللہ رات اور دن کا اندازہ رکھتا ہے۔ اس نے معلوم کیا کہ تم اسکو نباہ نہ سکو گے تو اس نے تم پر مہربانی کی پس جتنا آسانی سے ہو سکے اتنا قرآن پڑھ لیا کرو۔ اس نے جانا کہ تم میں بعض بیمار بھی ہوتے ہیں اور بعض اللہ کے فضل یعنی معاش کی تلاش میں ملک میں سفر کرینگے اور بعض اللہ کی راہ میں لڑیں گے تو جتنا آسانی سے ہو سکے اتنا پڑھ لیا کرو اور نماز قائم کرتے رہو اور زکوٰۃ ادا کرتے رہو اور اللہ کو نیک نیتی سے قرض دیتے رہو اور جو نیک عمل تم اپنے لئے آگے بھیجو گے اسکو اللہ کے ہاں بہتر اور صلے میں بہت عظیم پاؤ گے۔ اور اللہ سے بخشش مانگتے رہو۔ بیشک اللہ بخشنے والا اور مہربان ہے۔
paras.pashto: ژباړه: ستاسو پالونکی ښه پوهېږي چې ته او له تا سره خلک کله نږدې د شپې دوه پر درېیمه، کله نیمه شپه او کله د شپې درېیمه برخه ولاړ یاست؛ او الله د شپې او ورځې اندازه ساتي. هغه وپوهېد چې تاسو به یې پوره نشئ ساتلی، نو پر تاسو یې مهرباني وکړه؛ نو څومره چې اسانه وي، هومره قرآن لولئ. هغه وپوهېد چې په تاسو کې به ځینې ناروغان وي، ځینې به د الله د فضل، یعنې روزي په لټه کې په ځمکه کې سفر کوي، او ځینې به د الله په لاره کې جګړه کوي؛ نو څومره چې اسانه وي هومره لولئ، او لمونځ ودروئ او زکات ورکوئ، او الله ته ښه پور ورکوئ. او هر نېک عمل چې د ځان لپاره مخکې لېږئ، د الله سره به یې غوره او په بدله کې ډېر لوی ومومئ. او له الله بښنه غواړئ؛ بې‌شکه الله بښونکی او مهربان دی.

Translation: Your Lord knows well that you and the people with you sometimes stand at night nearly two-thirds of the night, and sometimes half the night, and sometimes a third of the night; and Allah keeps the measure of night and day. He knew that you would not be able to keep it up, so He was kind to you; so read as much of the Quran as is easy. He knew that some of you would be sick, and some would travel in the land seeking the bounty of Allah, i.e. livelihood, and some would fight in the way of Allah; so read as much as is easily possible, and keep establishing prayer and paying zakat, and keep giving Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good deed you send ahead for yourselves, you will find it with Allah better and greater in reward. And keep asking Allah for forgiveness; indeed Allah is forgiving and merciful.

paras.text: In this noble verse there is mention of the standing at night of the Noble Prophet ﷺ and his noble Companions (may Allah be pleased with them). Allah Most High says that He has knowledge of your and your companions’ standing in the night. It was said: recite the Quran Pak as much as you can with ease, and do not put yourselves into hardship, because sometimes people are also sick and are also on journey, and sometimes in search of livelihood they have also gone to other areas. And some mujahideen will fight in the way of Allah with the enemies of Allah and the rebels (unbelievers). Therefore read as much as you can with ease.

sections.content:
Explanation

In this noble verse there is mention of the standing at night of the Noble Prophet ﷺ and his noble Companions (may Allah be pleased with them). Allah Most High says that He has knowledge of your and your companions’ standing in the night. It was said: recite the Quran Pak as much as you can with ease, and do not put yourselves into hardship, because sometimes people are also sick and are also on journey, and sometimes in search of livelihood they have also gone to other areas. And some mujahideen will fight in the way of Allah with the enemies of Allah and the rebels (unbelievers). Therefore read as much as you can with ease.

It was also said: keep establishing prayer, keep paying zakat regularly, and keep spending in the way of Allah with large-heartedness. In this verse spending in the way of Allah has been declared synonymous with giving a loan to Allah. On the Day of Judgement Allah Most High will return this loan greatly increased. Whatever property is spent in the way of Allah, its best reward will be found with Allah Most High. Besides this there is also the command to seek forgiveness. Indeed Allah Most High is most kind and forgiving.

Surah al-Mutaffifin, verse number 1

وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِيْنَ

Translation: Woe to those who give less in measure and weight.

Explanation

In this noble verse a warning has been sounded for those who make shortage in measure and weight. For such people the word “wayl” has been used, i.e. for them there is ruin; it is a matter of regret and loss.

In daily dealings those people who, after receiving the full price of their things, make shortage in measure and weight … (continued on p.28)
